_source: Curated from the written guides in the Suika Box vault, chiefly 01.projects/03.no-mans-sky/20.refiner-recipes.md (nanite converters table) and 18.derelict-freighters.md. The game files record what a recipe needs, never where the ingredient is found, so this is the one hand-written file in the project. effort is a coarse rating of how much of a detour the item is: easy = you will pass some anyway, medium = a deliberate trip, hard = a specific hunt.

BP_SALVAGE.where: Buried beside Damaged Machinery — dig with the Terrain Manipulator
BP_SALVAGE.note: The Space Anomaly blueprints eat a few hundred; refine the rest at 15 nanites each.

AF_METAL.where: Derelict freighters, Corrupted Sentinels, Autophage camps
AF_METAL.note: Highest volume, not highest per unit: 150-500 from one derelict run.

SPACEGUNK2.where: Curious Deposits, which respawn every time you return to the planet
SPACEGUNK2.note: Gathering is trivial; at 5:1 and 150 s per nanite the refining is the whole cost.

SPACEGUNK4.where: Pressurised capsules and festering pustules inside derelict freighters
SPACEGUNK4.note: Refines to Runaway Mould, then to nanites.

FIENDCORE.note: Fastest nanites in the game per refiner, tied with Hadal Core.

FISHCORE.where: Underwater — hives and the sea floor

SHIPBRAIN.where: Corrupted-planet creatures, while hunting Sentinel Interceptors
SHIPBRAIN.note: 230 nanites in one inventory slot is unbeatable storage, but 53 min each: compact, not fast.

DRONE_SALVAGE.where: Byproduct of shooting Dissonant Resonators for Echo Locators
DRONE_SALVAGE.note: Piles up unused during Echo Locator farming — refine the surplus.

CLAMPEARL.where: Giant clams on the ocean floor
CLAMPEARL.note: Do not sell: one pearl refines into 100 Gold.

ROCKETSUB.where: Asteroids — a few minutes of shooting in any system

WATERWORLD1.where: Deep-ocean planets in purple systems, or refine Crystallised Helium + Quartzite

ALLOY7.where: Loot only — never a refiner output, unlike the other alloys

ALLOY8.where: Loot only — never a refiner output, unlike the other alloys

OXYGEN.where: Any planet — oxygen plants, or a Gas Extractor on a hotspot

FUEL1.where: Any planet — shoot any plant with the mining laser

GAS3.where: Atmosphere harvester on a Nitrogen hotspot

ASTEROID1.where: Asteroids — shoot them in any system

ASTEROID2.where: Asteroids — shoot them in any system
